text:
emma: PSA: my ISP went kaput mid-demo. sending this from my phone hotspot now. will share my 'before and after' WFH battlestation pics when i reclaim my desk. pic: <https://i.imgur.com/before-desk.jpg|before.jpg>
ryan: oh no! demo survivors club, welcome. :raised_hands: did you try power-cycling the modem?
emma: yep, unplugged, counted to 30, plugged back in. looked like it booted but no internet.
jules: if you have a spare travel router, you can create your own AP from your phone and tether. got me out of a blackout last month.
infra-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance for colo networks completed yesterday, no incidents reported. :white_check_mark:
ryan: also check for plan throttles? some ISPs do weird rate-limiting during high traffic.
arya: sharing my setup as moral support: <https://i.imgur.com/arya-setup.jpg|arya-desk.jpg> foam rollers and a big lamp = happiness. also router on a shelf helped my signal a bunch.
ryan: love the lamp. and the cat pillow.
dean: pro tip: cheap USB-C dock + single cable = instant tidy desk. worth it.
it-support: if it's recurring, DM us and we can arrange a loaner router or verify your modem config. also ping your ISP for a line test (they can detect noise on the line).
emma: called ISP, they opened a ticket. tethering for now. quick question: anyone tried a simple UPS for the modem + router? worried about flakey power causing reboots.
jules: i have a small UPS for router and it's been flawless during brownouts. picked one up from office clearance. :money_with_wings:
arya: UPS + a label that says "do not steal" works wonders in shared apartment settings. :joy:
ryan: unrelated but important: kudos to @emma for killing it in yesterday's demo even with spotty wifi. heard folks loved the flow. :trophy:
emma: thanks ryan, that means a lot. will post the "after" cable management photo once ISP behaves. may bribe the cat with treats for modelling. :cat:
infra-bot: Nightly deploy at 03:10 UTC completed. No remote-access changes. :rocket:
it-support: tagging resources: 1) router restart guide <https://intranet.redwood/it/router-restart>, 2) loaner request form <https://intranet.redwood/it/loaner>. DM if you want us to escalate the ISP ticket.
dean: also, for anyone thinking of upgrades: check the Redwood discount portal under People Ops — some home office gear deals pop up occasionally.
emma: will raid the portal. thanks everyone, love the quick tips. back to tethered life for now.
